name: la-grande-carte
description: French public open data on every commune, département, région, address and cadastral parcel.

interface.longDescription:
La Grande Carte gives ChatGPT read-only access to French public open data, curated and cross-referenced from about 40 official sources (INSEE, DGFiP, IGN, Géorisques, ADEME, ARS, SSMSI…).

Ask about any of France's ~35,000 communes: population, income and poverty, housing and advertised rents, tap-water quality, air quality, crime, climate, travel times, amenities, municipal finances, mayor and election results. Ask about a specific address or cadastral parcel: natural and industrial risks (flood, clay shrink-swell, radon, seismic, polluted sites), urban-planning zoning, recent property sales, energy ratings, noise, fibre and mobile coverage, protected areas and heritage. Départements, overseas included, and régions come with their own statistics.

Useful before moving, buying or renting, for due diligence on an address, to compare towns, and for local journalism or research on public statistics.

Limitations: France only (metropolitan France and the overseas départements). Read-only: it never changes anything. Owner names are not part of the public data and are never returned. Figures come from the latest official release of each source, which can be one to three years old. All data is under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0.

Connecting asks you to sign in to a La Grande Carte account (email and password, or Google).
capabilities: Look up any French commune's statistics
Assess risks, zoning and sales at an address
Find the cadastral parcel at an address or a point
defaultPrompt: What should I know about living in Bosdarros? How good is the tap water?
Natural risks, zoning and recent sales at 4 rue Porte Jaune, Bourges?
Compare median income, rents and crime between Pau and Tarbes.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the commune of Bosdarros, including the quality of its tap water.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Bosdarros (INSEE 64139, Pyrénées-Atlantiques) and reports its population, income figures and tap-water conformity, citing La Grande Carte.

positive.description: Due diligence on a street address
positive.prompt: What are the natural risks and the zoning at 4 rue Porte Jaune, 18000 Bourges?
positive.expected_behavior: Geocodes the address, finds cadastral parcel 18033000IO0129 in Bourges and reports its risk profile (flood status, drought and ground-movement history, seismic zone 2, radon category 1), nearby protected monuments and underground cavities. The historic centre has no PLU zone on record, and the answer says so rather than inventing one.

positive.prompt: Compare median income and crime rate between Pau and Tarbes.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up both communes and gives the median income and crime rate of each, from the same vintage, side by side.

positive.prompt: What is the population and the unemployment rate of La Réunion (974)?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the département La Réunion (974) with a population of about 881,000 and its unemployment rate.

positive.prompt: What do you know about cadastral parcel 18033000IO0129?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 266 m² parcel in Bourges (section IO, number 0129) and its enrichments: risks, zoning and recent sales nearby.

negative.description: Not a data lookup: travel booking
negative.prompt: Book me a train from Paris to Lyon tomorrow morning.
What are property prices in Brussels, Belgium?

negative.description: Personal data not served: property owner
negative.prompt: Who owns the house at 4 rue Porte Jaune in Bourges?

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing and processes no payments. It only reads public open data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: communes, départements, régions, addresses and cadastral parcels.

fr-FR.subtitle: Open data français, partout
fr-FR.description:
La Grande Carte donne à ChatGPT un accès en lecture seule aux données publiques françaises, croisées depuis une quarantaine de sources officielles (INSEE, DGFiP, IGN, Géorisques, ADEME, ARS, SSMSI…).

Interrogez n'importe laquelle des ~35 000 communes : population, revenus et pauvreté, logement et loyers, qualité de l'eau du robinet et de l'air, délinquance, climat, temps de trajet, équipements, finances, maire et résultats électoraux. Ou une adresse, une parcelle cadastrale : risques naturels et technologiques, zonage d'urbanisme, ventes récentes, DPE, bruit, fibre, zones protégées et patrimoine. Départements, outre-mer compris, et régions ont leurs propres statistiques.

Limites : France uniquement, lecture seule, jamais de nom de propriétaire. Données sous Licence Ouverte 2.0.

La connexion se fait avec un compte La Grande Carte (e-mail et mot de passe, ou Google).
